ADS_CONSENT_ITEM: • In-app consent manager (EEA, UK, Switzerland and US states with privacy laws). Where the law requires it, a consent screen (Google's User Messaging Platform, shown through AppLovin MAX) asks before any data is used for personalized ads, and lets you accept, reject or pick partners and purposes. You can reopen it at any time from {{APP}} Settings > Ad Privacy Choices to change or withdraw your consent, or to opt out of the "sale" or "sharing" of personal information for targeted advertising.
EMAIL_RECEIVED: your email address and what you write
REPLY_PROMISE: We usually reply within 2 business days and always within 7 days, and answer privacy requests within the time the law requires (30 days under GDPR, 45 days under CCPA).
PRERELEASE_NOTE: Pre-release draft, published before version 1.0 was released. It described an ad-supported free version that was never released.
V1_ROW: Version 1.0, the first released version of {{APP}}: no ads and no tracking (see No ads and no tracking).
APP_DATA_TRANSFERS: Your app data is not transferred anywhere, because it never leaves your device.
